programme.title: Most Daring
programme.desc: Tonight, on Most Daring ... from panic on the metro ... to horror on the highway ... A violent mob causes mayhem in a busy subway ... and only one man stands against them! A truck is caught on the tracks ... and ripped apart by a speeding train! A couple is trapped in the destructive path of an unrelenting freeway pile-up! Some nine-to-fivers see a perfect ten do an impromptu strip tease on the underground! These are the most heart-stopping moments ever caught on tape! True stories of real people ... in real danger! This is Most Daring – COMMUTER CHAOS!

programme.title: Most Daring
programme.desc: Tonight, on Most Daring ... from commotion in the classroom ... to fraternity fun gone foul ... school's out of control ... it's CAMPUS CHAOS! College kids revive a banned celebration ... but when it turns into a riot ... they'll have their class reunion in jail! A freewheeling nudist is confronted by police ... and tries a ballsy cross-campus escape! These are the most heart-stopping moments ... ever caught on tape! True stories of real people ... in real danger! This is Most Daring – CAMPUS CHAOS!

programme.title: Most Daring
programme.desc: Tonight, on Most Daring ... they're shortchanged on smarts ... and robbed of common sense ... they're CLUELESS CROOKS! A blackjack dealer is stunned by a stoner who tries to ante up with an ounce of pot! A desperate defendant loses a case ... and consciousness! A burglar's hard landing ... scores him nothing but pain! These are the most heart-stopping moments ever caught on tape! True stories of real people ... in real danger! This is Most Daring – CLUELESS CROOKS!

programme.title: Most Daring
programme.desc: Tonight, on Most Daring! You could be caught off guard ... but once you're staring down the barrel of danger ... all you can do is BRACE FOR IMPACT! In the hands of two twisted friends, a backhoe becomes a vehicle for destruction ... and pain! A daredevil wrestles with Nature's fury ... and gets the mother of all smack-downs! Cops pursue a driver with a death wish ... and he doesn't care who's along for the ride! A lead foot in a hurry leaves a cyclist for dead! These are the most heart-stopping moments ... ever caught on tape! True stories of real people ... in real danger! This is, Most Daring – BRACE FOR IMPACT!

programme.title: Most Daring
programme.desc: Tonight, on Most Daring! They're bombed, blitzed ... and baked ... and facing STONE COLD JUSTICE! ... a wobbly trip to the bathroom ... gets a drunk girl truly pasted! These are the most heart-stopping moments ... ever caught on tape! True stories of real people ... in real danger! This is, Most Daring – STONE COLD JUSTICE!

programme.title: Red Riding: 1983
programme.desc: When another child goes missing, washed-up solicitor John Piggott unwittingly provides a catalyst for Detective Chief Superindent Maurice Jobson to start to right some wrongs.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Master filmmaker Sidney Lumet (The Verdict, Dog Day Afternoon, Serpico) delivers "one of his greatest achievements" (Roger Ebert) with this riveting and compelling suspense thriller. Oscar®-winner* Philip Seymour Hoffman (Capote) is Andy, an overextended payroll executive who lures his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke, Training Day), into a larcenous scheme: the pair will rob a suburban mom-and-pop jewelry store that appears to be the quintessential easy target. The problem is, the store owners are Andy and Hank's real mom and pop, and when the seemingly perfect crime goes awry, the damage sends them hurtling toward a shattering clash that may obliterate their already precarious lives.

programme.title: The Pledge
programme.desc: The night he retires as a Nevada sheriff, Jerry Black (Nicholson) pledges to the mother of a murdered girl that he will find the killer. Jerry doesn't believe the police arrested the right man; he discovers this is the third incident in the area in the recent past with victims young, blond, pretty, and small for their age.

programme.title: 10th And Wolf
programme.desc: A former street tough returns to his Philadelphia home after a stint in the military. Back on his home turf, he once again finds himself tangling with the mob boss who was instrumental in his going off to be a soldier.
